prompts: Remember the little archery games of the Windows 95 days? We want the first level of one, our own, in {WS}/game/index.html, a single file. An archer you aim with the mouse, pulling the bow back for power, balloons to pop, a score on screen, a way to start and a way to lose. How it looks, plays and sounds is your call, and that is what we care about most: a minute of play should be fun, and every shot and hit should feel and sound good. It is reviewed by opening the file, with no build step, in a browser that reaches only Google Fonts, and by playing it.
answers:
**[goal]** Build the first level of an original Windows 95-style archery game as one file, `game/index.html`. It needs mouse aiming, a bow you pull back for power, balloons, a score, a way to start and a way to lose, with good feel and sound.

**[action]**
- Wrote one HTML file that draws everything on a canvas. The only outside file is the Google Fonts "Press Start 2P" font, and it falls back to monospace if that doesn't load.
- **Controls:** hold the mouse button to draw the bow. Power fills over about 0.75 s, shown by a green-to-red bar. A dotted line shows where the arrow will fly, the bowstring pulls back visibly, and the bow creaks as it fills. Releasing fires the arrow, which drops under gravity and leaves a trail.
- **Sound:** made in the browser with Web Audio, so there are no sound files. There is a twang that rises in pitch with power, a pop that gets higher with each extra balloon one arrow pops, a soft tone on a miss, and short tunes for winning and losing. Hits also shake the screen, burst into confetti and float the points.
- **Rules (my assumptions):** pop 15 balloons with 20 arrows. You lose when the arrows run out first. A normal balloon is worth 10, a gold one 50 (smaller and faster). Popping several balloons with one arrow multiplies the points, and each spare arrow at the end adds 25.
- **Screens:** a title screen with instructions, "click to start", and "click to play again" after a win or a loss. The page scales to fit the window.

**[result]**
- The automatic page check after writing the file reported: `render check: 0 console errors`. Its screenshot shows the title, the instructions, the archer, the balloons and the meadow drawn correctly, with the font loaded.
- **Not checked:** I did not play it in a browser. Aiming, power, hits, the score, sound, and the win and lose screens have only been checked by reading the code. I opened no browser tabs or apps, so there was nothing to close.

**[next]** Open `game/index.html` and play one round to judge how the power curve and the sounds feel.
